paper: Tian et al., Adv Mater 2026, Fig S11
what: group means of the same 486 formulations as Fig 2c; a consistency check, not new per-formulation data

crosscheck_interpretation.statistic_mismatch: Fig 2c gives a mean BIN INDEX (1-4); Fig S11 gives a geometric GROUP MEAN in RLU. These are different statistics, so only the rank order is comparable, and only where groups are actually separated.
crosscheck_interpretation.where_the_paper_reports_significance: S11c (DODAP) is marked **** and S11d's DSPC comparisons are ****. Both match: DODAP 50 > 30 > 10 exactly, and DSPC is top in both.
crosscheck_interpretation.where_orders_differ: S11a (C6O2B2) and S11b (DMG-PEG) are marked 'ns' by the authors, and the differing pairs are near-ties (35 vs 65 at 2.1e5 both; 1 vs 2 at 2.1 vs 2.2e5). The DMPC/EggSM swap in S11d is likewise a 6.5e5 vs 4.0e5 adjacent pair against a coarse 4-level proxy.
crosscheck_interpretation.verdict: consistent; no disagreement anywhere the source data separates the groups.
